items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a thickening X subset X' of algebraic spaces over a scheme S and an affine object U of X_{spaces,etale}, the restriction map Gamma(U, O_{X'}) -> Gamma(U, O_X) is surjective, where O_{X'} is viewed as a sheaf on the etale site of X (statement lines 1684-1694). The author gives two proofs and both are retained here in their original order: the first moves the affine object along the equivalence of etale topoi to an affine scheme U' over X' and reduces to a closed immersion of affine schemes, while the second treats the finite order case by reducing to a square-zero kernel and running the long exact cohomology sequence with the vanishing of H^1 on affines (proof lines 1696-1726). The second proof is the one that carries the technique used later in the chapter, since it converts a statement about thickenings into a statement about quasi-coherent cohomology on an affine object; the first is short but complete. H2.
